summary: John's 4th great-uncle; brother of Maria Anna Birkenmayer; emigrant to Sandusky, Ohio.
bio:
Born 15 Mar 1842, baptized 19 Mar 1842 at Munzingen (No. 6): 'Joseph Birkenmayer, ehelicher Sohn des Servatius Birkenmayer, hiesigen Bürgers und Glasers, und der Agatha Heizler'; witnesses Gabriel Ott, farmer, and Johann Schell, teacher. The Ancestry index (snippet) has a Joseph Birkenmeier, b. 15 Mar 1842 'Münzingen', Breisgau, parents Servatius Birkenmayer and Agatha Heitzler, d. 3 Nov 1904 Sandusky, Erie Co., Ohio — the clue that led to Munzingen. Munzingen had an emigrant pipeline to northern Ohio. Not in the 1889 History of Erie County biographies (B).

Joseph was still at home in Munzingen in March 1863. When his sister Maria Anna's second child, Franziska (later Frances Meier Miller), was baptized on 10 Mar 1863, the godfather was 'Joseph Birkenmaier, Taglöhner, twenty-year-old single son of the late Servaz Birkenmaier of here'. He also signed as a witness ([R4-S1]). The age fits his birth on 15 Mar 1842 exactly. So he emigrated to Ohio after March 1863. A Sandusky obituary (Nov 1904) is still unread: the Hayes Ohio Obituary Index search page could not be driven from here, and the Erie County USGenWeb obituary page has no Birkenmeier.
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, Standesbücher 1840–1870; 631 images; record id 5-480947), births 1842 No. 6 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-62

[R4-S1] Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, kath., Standesbücher 1840–1870), Geburtsbuch 1863 No. 3, p. 503 (image 447); index 'Register pro 1863' (image 454): 'Mayer Franziska, 502' (primary) http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-447
openQuestions: Sandusky Register obituary Nov 1904 (Hayes Presidential Center obituary index https://www.rbhayes.org/) — may name Munzingen and a sister in Hazleton.
Emigration falls between Mar 1863 and his appearance in Ohio. Check the Bezirksamt Freiburg Auswanderungsakten, 1863–1870.
Hayes Ohio Obituary Index (rbhayes.org) for Birkenmeier, Sandusky, Nov 1904 — the search is JavaScript-driven and needs a browser.
